messages:
elaine-partners: Quick kickstart for the cloud marketplace pilot. Need owners for AWS/GCP/Azure KMS, metering mapping, EULA telemetry language, and packaging assets. EU customers require regional keys.

elaine-partners: Checklist:
- Region-specific KMS/CMEK/KeyVault provisioning
- SKU -> meter dimension mapping
- Telemetry & trial text for EULA
- Packaging: icons, 1-line, long copy, screenshots

toby-aws-eng: I'll do AWS KMS (us-west-2, eu-west-1). Will produce CFN/CloudFormation snippets and cross-account policy.

nik-infra: GCP CMEK + service account will be created in europe-west1 and us-central1. Service account: marketplace-onboard@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com

sara-legal: EULA draft: "We collect aggregated usage metrics for billing, service quality, and abuse detection. Customers can opt out of non-essential telemetry; opting out may affect trial features." Also add logs retention: 30 days; aggregated usage: 90 days.

michael-product: Packaging assets: short tagline: "Predictable, low-latency LLM inference." I'll draft longer copy and screenshots.

elaine-partners: Action items assigned. Will collect vendor metering credentials once vendor portal returns them. :thumbsup:
